text.title: AI-Assisted Development — Worked Example
text.summary: One complete workflow record for a billing platform (seven-class map across Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot; eight-area block-list; three context files; .cursorignore; retention checked; August comparison showing higher churn and the map tightened) with a note on each non-obvious value, then the "Copilot for everything" record and what the validator prints.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: acme/billing, a Python service. Developers have used Copilot and Claude Code informally for six months. Two AI-assisted PRs were reverted in July, one for a `verify=False` in the payments client. swe:alice writes the workflow record, runs the first monthly comparison on August's PRs, and tightens the refactor checkpoint after churn comes out higher.

example.title: billing-platform record 1.1.0
example.code: { "team": {"name": "billing-platform", "repo_url": "https://github.com/acme/billing", "record_version": "1.1.0"}, "owner": "swe:alice", "inputs": [ {"name": "tool_task_map", "value": [ {"task_class": "boilerplate-scaffolding", "tool": "claude-code", "checkpoint": "self-review"}, {"task_class": "unit-tests", "tool": "claude-code", "checkpoint": "one-reviewer"}, {"task_class": "refactor", "tool": "cursor", "checkpoint": "one-reviewer"}, {"task_class": "code-review", "tool": "copilot", "checkpoint": "one-reviewer"}, {"task_class": "documentation", "tool": "claude-code", "checkpoint": "self-review"}, {"task_class": "data-migration", "tool": "ai-off", "checkpoint": "ai-off"}, {"task_class": "infrastructure", "tool": "claude-code", "checkpoint": "two-reviewers-non-prompter"} ]}, {"name": "block_list", "value": [ {"area": "authentication-session", "paths": ["src/billing/auth/**"], "policy": "ai-off"}, {"area": "authorization", "paths": ["src/billing/permissions/**"], "policy": "two-reviewers-non-prompter"}, {"area": "cryptography-keys", "paths": ["src/billing/crypto/**"], "policy": "ai-off"}, {"area": "payments-billing", "paths": ["src/billing/charges/**", "src/billing/invoices/**"], "policy": "two-reviewers-non-prompter"}, {"area": "pii-processing", "paths": ["src/billing/customers/**"], "policy": "two-reviewers-non-prompter"}, {"area": "secrets-config-loading", "paths": ["src/billing/config.py", "deploy/secrets/**"], "policy": "ai-off"}, {"area": "production-iac", "paths": ["infra/prod/**"], "policy": "two-reviewers-non-prompter"}, {"area": "database-migrations", "paths": ["migrations/**"], "policy": "ai-off"} ]}, {"name": "context_files", "value": [ {"tool": "claude-code", "path": "CLAUDE.md", "last_reviewed": "2026-09-01"}, {"tool": "cursor", "path": ".cursor/rules", "last_reviewed": "2026-09-01"}, {"tool": "copilot", "path": ".github/copilot-instructions.md", "last_reviewed": "2026-09-01"} ]}, {"name": "exclusion_file", "value": {"path": ".cursorignore", "excludes": [".env*", "deploy/secrets/**", "data/exports/**", "fixtures/customers/**"]}}, {"name": "tool_retention", "value": [ {"tool": "claude-code", "terms_checked": true, "source": "https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms", "checked_on": "2026-08-28"}, {"tool": "cursor", "terms_checked": true, "source": "https://cursor.com/privacy", "checked_on": "2026-08-28"}, {"tool": "copilot", "terms_checked": true, "source": "https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/manage-your-account/managing-copilot-policies-as-an-individual-subscriber", "checked_on": "2026-08-28"} ]}, {"name": "prompt_template", "value": {"path": "templates/prompt-code.txt", "blocks": ["Context", "Task", "Requirements", "Output"]}}, {"name": "ai_assisted_label", "value": {"label": "ai-assisted", "auto_merge_disabled": true}} ], "decision": "Claude Code for scaffolding, tests and docs, Cursor for refactors, Copilot for review suggestions; infrastructure only with two non-prompter reviewers; data migrations, auth, crypto and secrets loading are ai-off.", "evidence": [ "https://github.com/acme/billing/blob/main/CLAUDE.md", "https://github.com/acme/billing/blob/main/.cursorignore", "https://grafana.example.com/d/pr-quality?var-label=ai-assisted&from=1751328000000&to=1756684800000" ], "review": { "cadence": "monthly", "next_review_at": "2026-10-01", "last_outcome": { "period": "2026-08", "ai_assisted": {"pr_count": 41, "defect_escape_rate": 0.047, "revert_rate": 0.024, "churn_2w_rate": 0.17}, "other": {"pr_count": 63, "defect_escape_rate": 0.048, "revert_rate": 0.032, "churn_2w_rate": 0.09}, "worse_on": ["churn_2w_rate"], "map_tightened": true, "action": "refactor moved from self-review to one-reviewer; record_version bumped 1.0.0 to 1.1.0", "url": "https://grafana.example.com/d/pr-quality?var-label=ai-assisted&from=1751328000000&to=1756684800000" } } }
example.note: All seven task classes are mapped; data migrations are `ai-off` on both tool and checkpoint, and infrastructure is allowed only with two non-prompter reviewers (r-tool-to-task-map-written, r-security-critical-block-list). The block-list carries all eight minimum areas with real paths; auth, crypto, secrets loading and migrations are `ai-off`, the rest need two reviewers (r-security-critical-block-list). Each of the three tools has a context file reviewed on 2026-09-01 (r-repo-context-file-maintained). `.cursorignore` excludes env files, secrets and customer exports, and every tool's retention terms were read on 2026-08-28 with the source recorded (r-no-secrets-or-customer-data-in-prompts). The prompt template is the four-block one (r-structured-prompt-four-blocks). The label is set and auto-merge is off (r-ai-diff-reviewed-like-human-code). The August comparison shows AI-assisted PRs at 17 percent two-week churn against 9 percent, so `worse_on` lists churn, refactor moved from self-review to one-reviewer, and `record_version` went 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 (r-defect-rate-tracked-ai-vs-human). Dependency verification and the break-the-function test check happen per PR under the checkpoints and are not fields of the record (r-verify-introduced-dependencies-and-apis, r-ai-tests-must-assert-and-fail-when-broken).

example.title: Copilot for everything
example.note: What the validator prints: `data-migration` at `self-review` and `infrastructure` at `one-reviewer`, below the two-reviewer floor (r-security-critical-block-list); `block_list` has 1 of the 8 required areas (r-security-critical-block-list); `prompt_template.blocks` is not the four blocks (r-structured-prompt-four-blocks); `ai_assisted_label.label` is empty and `auto_merge_disabled` is false (r-ai-diff-reviewed-like-human-code); `last_outcome.worse_on` lists all three metrics with `map_tightened: false` and no `action` (r-defect-rate-tracked-ai-vs-human); cross-field: Copilot is in the map with no `context_files` entry (r-repo-context-file-maintained) and with `terms_checked: false` (r-no-secrets-or-customer-data-in-prompts). What the reviewer sees: 80 AI-assisted PRs against 20 others, a 9 percent defect escape rate, and a decision that says nothing is ai-off (fm-ai-everywhere-no-map).
